description: For the same Boolean valuation, satisfaction of a rule's associated shared clause is equivalent to satisfaction of the rule by the valuation's true set.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.clause_bridge.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Rule α) (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.ruleClause r) ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HornClauses.Holds r {p | v p = true}
